title: City · See-through cut in buildings
description: With the camera held at its own angle (?camara=fija), in the open city buildings keep their height: when one stands between Gerard and the camera, a round window opens in it round him and its rim dissolves (scripts/screenshots/hidden-view.json compares the other styles), instead of the whole block folding down. Interiors still fold their walls.

steps.caption: Out on the avenue nothing is in the way, so every building stands whole
Deep in the passage between two blocks: the block in front opens a window round Gerard and keeps its height
Deep in the passage between two blocks: the block in front opens a hole round Gerard and keeps its height
On the near pavement, behind the blocks by the camera: only the window round Gerard, the rest of the facade and its roof stay
On the near pavement, behind the blocks by the camera: only the hole, the rest of the facade and its roof stay
